steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Definition: Hardware refers to the physical components of a computer system - the parts you can see and touch. Hardware includes all the electronic and mechanical parts that make up the computer. | Definition: Software refers to the programs, instructions, and data that tell the hardware what to do. Software is not physical - it is the set of instructions that the hardware executes. | Key Concept: Hardware and software are interdependent. Hardware needs software to give it instructions; software needs hardware to execute those instructions. Neither can function without the other. | Definition: System software manages and controls the hardware and provides a platform for application software to run on. It runs in the background and the user may not directly interact with it.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Define the terms hardware and software. | Explain why hardware and software are interdependent. | Classify each as input, output, or storage: keyboard, monitor, SSD, scanner, speaker, USB drive.
